answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains without measurable retention harm. Memories 31, 44, and 86 provide fairly strong but more indirect evidence through durable activation, pipeline quality, and time-to-value improvements. Memory 91 supports engagement and first meaningful action, but does not establish revenue or retention impact. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift from promotional pricing, but omits evidence of qualified revenue quality, retention, profitability, or durability—especially important given price-sensitive segments and a competitor price war.
